name: Stable Universe
desc: Raise the floor that a planet's output decays down to, by a factor of {v}. Unlike a planet's own infrastructure, this applies on every planet at once.

name: Patient Universe
desc: Multiply the speed at which a planet's output decays by {v}. Lower is better - your production stays high for longer.

name: Stellar Cartography
desc: Shorten every journey to a planet you have already reached by a factor of {v}.

name: Cargo Compression
desc: Multiply the total weight of your ship and its cargo by {v}. Lower is better - a lighter ship travels faster.

name: Essence Refinement
desc: Multiply all Star Essence you gain by a factor of {v}.

name: Automated Arrival
desc: Research and buildings start by themselves when you land. Level 2 skips what you cannot run, level 3 sorts the priority list, level 4 keeps it through a Big Bang.

name: Ballast Trim
desc: Cargo weighs far less in flight. Without this a full hold makes a journey take thousands of times as long. At the top level it is 1.7 times, half a load 1.4.

name: Cargo Bay Doors
desc: Jettison the hold on departure and seal it for the flight, so nothing leaks back in. Level 2 lets you pick which resources go overboard and which stay.

name: Quantum Pocket
desc: A weightless pocket that catches everything you earn while travelling. Research and infrastructure can spend from it in flight, and it never slows you down.

name: Offline Reserve
desc: Time keeps counting while the game is shut, up to one day. Every level banks another day, so at level 6 you can be away a whole week and come back to all of it.

name: Offline Vault
desc: Banks another week of offline time per level, on top of Offline Reserve. All fifteen is sixteen weeks, so a season away still comes back to you in full.

name: Planetary Memory
desc: Keep a share of the infrastructure bonuses from planets you are not standing on. 2% of your best per level, so 30% at max, wherever you fly.
